method: Actual imagegen: six new originals and one imagegen edit, transparent_background:true. Six selected outputs and one preserved rejected original.

attempts.prompt: Create a NEW original kotobabin achievement stamp artwork using the reference ONLY for watercolor style, NOT its map, buds or pebble subjects. Warm Japanese storybook watercolor/gouache, honey-ochre wood, cream paper, muted sage and restrained terracotta, soft paper grain INSIDE painted shapes. Large clear silhouettes recognizable at 72px. One frame-free square composition with genuine transparent background outside the freestanding scene and generous clear outer margins. NO printed words, letters, numbers, title, UI status, symbols, stamp border or perforations. No opaque rectangular background. A LOW HORIZONTAL ROW OF BLANK LETTERS/envelopes held neatly between two simple wooden BOOKENDS on one thin horizontal wooden plank. A small natural HUMAN HAND reaches FROM ABOVE, gently sliding the FINAL CREAM ENVELOPE into the row. Keep envelope edges broad and readable, row low and wide, hand clearly entering from above; no mailbox, no tall pile, no trees. Three-quarter view slightly from above, warm calm completion.
attempts.rejection: Three floating gold emphasis rays were not part of the canonical physical still life.

Preserve all physical hand, envelope, wooden plank and bookend shapes and gentle watercolor style; no enclosing frame.
